description: Creates or deletes a maintenance window for status.io.

parameters.name: all_infrastructure_affected
parameters.description: If it affects all components and containers. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: api_id
parameters.description: Your unique API ID from status.io.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Your unique API Key from status.io.

parameters.name: automation
parameters.description: Automatically start and end the maintenance window. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: components
parameters.description: The given name of your component (server name).

parameters.name: containers
parameters.description: The given name of your container (data center).

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Message describing the maintenance window. Default: "Created by Ansible"

parameters.name: maintenance_id
parameters.description: The maintenance ID number when deleting a maintenance window.

parameters.name: maintenance_notify_1_hr
parameters.description: Notify subscribers 1 hour before maintenance start time. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: maintenance_notify_24_hr
parameters.description: Notify subscribers 24 hours before maintenance start time. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: maintenance_notify_72_hr
parameters.description: Notify subscribers 72 hours before maintenance start time. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: maintenance_notify_now
parameters.description: Notify subscribers now. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: The duration of the maintenance window (starting from playbook runtime). Default: 10

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Date maintenance is expected to start (Month/Day/Year) (UTC). End Date is worked out from start_date + minutes.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Time maintenance is expected to start (Hour:Minutes) (UTC). End Time is worked out from start_time + minutes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Desired state of the package. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: statuspage
parameters.description: Your unique StatusPage ID from status.io.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A descriptive title for the maintenance window. Default: "A new maintenance window"

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Status.io API URL. A private apiary can be used instead. Default: "https://api.status.io"

examples:
- name: Create a maintenance window for 10 minutes on server1, with automation to stop the maintenance
  community.general.statusio_maintenance:
    title: Router Upgrade from ansible
    desc: Performing a Router Upgrade
    components: server1.example.com
    api_id: api_id
    api_key: api_key
    statuspage: statuspage_id
    maintenance_notify_1_hr: true
    automation: true

- name: Create a maintenance window for 60 minutes on server1 and server2
  community.general.statusio_maintenance:
    title: Routine maintenance
    desc: Some security updates
    components:
      - server1.example.com
      - server2.example.com
    minutes: 60
    api_id: api_id
    api_key: api_key
    statuspage: statuspage_id
    maintenance_notify_1_hr: true
    automation: true
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Create a future maintenance window for 24 hours to all hosts inside the Primary Data Center
  community.general.statusio_maintenance:
    title: Data center downtime
    desc: Performing a Upgrade to our data center
    components: Primary Data Center
    api_id: api_id
    api_key: api_key
    statuspage: statuspage_id
    start_date: 01/01/2016
    start_time: 12:00
    minutes: 1440

- name: Delete a maintenance window
  community.general.statusio_maintenance:
    title: Remove a maintenance window
    maintenance_id: 561f90faf74bc94a4700087b
    statuspage: statuspage_id
    api_id: api_id
    api_key: api_key
    state: absent
